spec.semantic_contract: Nested Loop/StridedLoop implicit seeded fold declaration belongs to enclosing loop body; restore ancestor binding at body exit; keep seedFalse carried updates and current-loop own finalized export.

tolerance_justification: Exactly representable F32 integer folds. Explicit public nested-fold scope rule, no repeated pure SSA declaration. Nested owned state shadows ancestor Init inside Loop body; empty bodies cannot leak undefined inner bindings. seedFalse updates persist; fresh direct owned carrier exports finalized value, then is shadowed only inside StridedLoop body. Positive inner output writes repeat sequentially per lane, identical final value; full output coverage and partial Tile tail. NumPy eight-column algebra independent of compiler.
